notes.title: Update - Early Game Balancing
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16354940/8d435aadc4c31954f735f5d2d078ebe1b1f7ab90.jpg[/img]

Hi guys,

This is for new players having problems with the difficulty of the game, especially after completing the tutorials and starting with the real missions – using the basic equipment. 

[b]Important: I did not change anything for the Gold difficulty players, so the game did not become easier in general, just the lower difficulty levels got an update.[/b]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[b]Halloween Mode deactivated[/b]
The Halloween skin won't be active on new installations, but you can still activate & deactivate it in the settings. Maybe some of you prefer the dark skin over the default white one.

[b]Tutorial RAM doubled[/b]
This means that new players will be able to unlock 2 upgrades in the Uplab after completing the 3 tutorial missions (instead of 1 item). This should help to get a better start.

[b]Soother Challenge Changes[/b]
The Start RAM in the early Soother challenges increased. This seemed to be an issue for a minority of new players.

[b]Impact on Creep Spawn[/b]
The lower difficulty levels (Bronze and Silver) have now a bigger impact on the ingame values like creep spawn ratio, creep speed deviation, boss spawn cooldown, start RAM amount, and much more ...

[b]Soother [/b]
The first 3 challenges in Soother got easier. I changed the start RAM and the cookie travel speed. This was a topic for some new players, who had problems hitting the fast moving cookies and could not complete the missions because of RAM shortages.

[b]Video Tutorials[/b]
The first System (Soother) got a video tutorial link when starting the first challenges (Get Started). This is to ensure, that the player understands the basic mechanics. I will add much more video links in the future, this is just the beginning.

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
I am already working on the next patch, which will target some mid- and endgame balancing.

Over and out! :-)

Have a nice day,
Thiemo

notes.title: First Major Update - 2 weeks of community driven progress
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16354940/f905da59cb483b0c470edba4700f7351caaf5539.png[/img]

Hi guys,

As announced 2 days ago, I updated the game and added a totally new movement mode (Direct Mode). For huge games studios, this would not be a big deal, but for a solo-developed indie game I would call this the first major update since the release.

It's now been about 2 weeks since Artificial Defense was released. I got some bug reports, a lot of feature requests and a ton of motivating messages. Honestly I did not expect to get so much support from the community and I was a little bit steamrolled by you guys - in a very positive way. Thank you so much for your interest in this little game! :-)

Well, let's talk about what happened in the last 2 weeks:

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[b]Major change: Direct Mode[/b]
I personally like the default controls, but some of you told me, that they don't get used to the cursor driven input scheme and other complained about the fact that they had to hold LM for dragging the map. Of course you guys were totally right - and honestly my wife told me the same a few months ago. - Well, I addressed this issues by introducing a new movement mode, called "Direct Mode". You can now move the map (or the crosshair - with inverted controls activated) without holding a button. Additionally you can toggle this mode at any time, this way I do not need to change the default controls - since a majority like it this way. Sounds like a minor change but the guys, who had problems with the default movement scheme may notice a huge improvement. By the way: In combination with inverted controls it feels like a common shooter scheme, actually.

[b]Force Launcher Dialogue:[/b]
I most cases everything should be fine, but in some rare cases you might want to tweak some settings before launch. Just hold SHIFT while the game is started and you will get access to a Launcher Dialogue, which enables you to edit key-mapping and some display settings. The dialogue is hidden by default, because of Full-Controller-Support compatibility reasons.

[b]Minor changes and a couple of fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]New achievement re-report emergency button
[*]Display weapon stats
[*]Tweaking tutorial texts and adding more information
[*]Controller / Mouse switch issue fixed
[*]FPS issue fixed (games run on some machines at 700+ fps)
[*]fixed a couple of minor issues and flaws
[/list]

[h1] Thank you very much for your support guys![/h1]
Thiemo

P.S. If you encounter any issues, just tell me. I will get back to you asap! ;-)

Additionally you can toggle this mode at any time, this way I do not need to change the default controls - since a majority like it this way. Sounds like a minor change but the guys, who had problems with the default movement scheme may notice a huge improvement. By the way: In combination with inverted controls it feels like a common shooter scheme, actually.

[b]Force Launcher Dialogue:[/b]
I most cases everything should be fine, but in some rare cases you might want to tweak some settings before launch. Just hold SHIFT while the game is started and you will get access to a Launcher Dialogue, which enables you to edit key-mapping and some display settings. The dialogue is hidden by default, because of Full-Controller-Support compatibility reasons.

[b]Minor changes and a couple of fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]New achievement re-report emergency button
[*]Display weapon stats
[*]Tweaking tutorial texts and adding more information
[*]Controller / Mouse switch issue fixed
[*]FPS issue fixed (games run on some machines at 700+ fps)
[*]fixed a couple of minor issues and flaws
[/list]

[h1] Thank you very much for your support guys![/h1]
Thiemo

P.S. If you encounter any issues, just tell me. I will get back to you asap! ;-)

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Hi guys,

The first update / patch is now online. It's not a big deal actually, but it fixes a lot of annoying issues and brings some first, technical improvements.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[b]Re-Report Achievements Button[/b]
Usefull if something weired happend during the achievement report. A player recently reported that his achievements were not synced during offline play.

[b]Alternative key to move the map[/b]
Some of you told me, that they do not like to use the left mouse button so frequently, so I added an alternative key (Left Alt). If you hold it, the cursor dissapears and you can move the map, as if you would hold LM. I prefer LM myself, but that is a matter of taste I guess.

[b]Force Launch Dialogue[/b]
Some guys told me that the need to remap keys e.g. when using country specific keyboard layouts. Others want to change the display which is used for the game. You can now edit these settings in the Launch Dialogue. Since this is a Full-Controller-Support flagged game the launcher will only show up, when holding down the "SHIFT" key while starting the game. This is not a perfect solution, but it brings some options to those guys who encountered issues. This topic has still a place on my todo list.

[b]FPS Isues[/b]
Some guys reported that the game runs with about 700fps on their machine, sounds nice but it devours a lot of unnecessary hardware performance. I limited the game to a maximum of 140fps now.

[b]Other issues[/b]
A bunch of minor issues and some typos were fixed.

This is of course not the last update I will fire, it's just the first one. Please continue to report all issue you encounter. I am constantly working on the game.

Have a nice day,
Thiemo

notes.title: Thank you for your awesome feedback!
notes.content:
Thank you very much guys for your awesome feedback. The overall satisfaction seems to be  good and I am very happy about it - but this does not mean, that I will put my feet up - quite the contrary! - It's still a 1.0.0.0 version and my todo list got very long, after talking with you guys. ;-)

[h1]What are you currently doing?[/h1]
I am currently working on the first small update, which will be published very soon. This one will handle a couple of technical issues some of you encountered. 

[h1]Interested in the development?[/h1]
I know that a lot of you guys are developers themselves or at least interested in the development. If you have any questions concerning my development, please do not hesitat to contact me. I may need some time to reply, since I have to prioritize bug-fixing, but I def. will get back to you asap.

[h1]Delays[/h1]
Sometimes I can not answer a new discussion or a message instantly, since I have to work on the game itself - and modifying the code e.g. needs some undisturbed concentration. The advantage of a solo-development is that the communication is very direct, there is no community manager in between us for instance - but on the other hand I have a lot of work, spread on very different tasks: updates, patching, community, a little bit promotion, etc. - so sometimes I may just need more time. I kindly ask for your understanding ;-)

I hope you enjoy my little game.

Hava a nice day,
Thiemo

notes.title: Version 0.9.9.1 (PR)
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Version 0.9.9.1 brings us 2 new features:

[h1]1. Video tutorials[/h1]
We do not like to read texts in games, check! Hence I added three tutorial videos, showing how I play the game. I decided to host the videos on youtube and use links instead of ingame video content. This has three advantages:

A: Minimal diskspace usage
B: I can edit the youtube videos without uploading a new game version
C: We can use the youTube comments section to discuss your tutorial video related questions.

[h1]2. Hall of Fame[/h1]
There is one user, which helped me a lot since the very early version of my game. We do not know each other and he basically lives at the other side of our planet, but he constantly helped me with testing the game and he has some serious talent in finding bugs ;-) - The new Hall of Fame section is a place were I can give credits to him. I hope that others will join, so that I can put some more names on this list in the future.

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
There were no major bugs, but a ton of minor issues. If you find anything strange just send an ingame bug-report. I try to update the game every few days, so that we have a very stable and enjoyable game at the release day. 

Thank you very much for your interest in my humble game.

Kind regards,
Thiemo
